svg.title: An agent run from start to end
svg.desc: The system checks that AI and the agent are on, builds a plan from the module's template, and works step by step. It checks that the tool is registered. Reads and drafts run at once within the level. A write or a notice waits for a permitted person, and approval calls the module's normal command. Every step is logged.
